function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a text file. Returns numbered lines. Use offset/limit for large files.

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List a directory (dirs end with /). depth 1-4.

function.name: glob
function.description: Find files by glob pattern, e.g. '**/*.py' or 'src/**/test_*.ts'. Newest first.

function.name: grep
function.description: Search file contents with a regular expression. Returns path:line:text.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create a file or replace its entire content. Prefer edit_file for small changes.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace an exact string in a file. old_string must match exactly (including indentation) and be unique unless replace_all is true. new_string REPLACES old_string entirely: to insert code next to an anchor line, repeat the anchor line in new_string.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a shell command (bash on Linux/macOS, PowerShell on Windows) and return its output. Non-interactive: stdin is closed. Default timeout 120 s.

function.name: fetch_url
function.description: Fetch a web page or API over HTTP(S) and return its text.

function.name: remember
function.description: Save one durable fact about the user to long-term memory, as a self-contained third-person sentence (e.g. 'User prefers pnpm over npm.'). Never store secrets.

function.name: recall
function.description: Search long-term memory about the user. Empty query lists everything.

function.name: forget
function.description: Delete a memory by id (ids are shown in brackets).

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Show the user a short task plan and its progress. Send the full list each time.

function.name: switch_mode
function.description: Switch how the user talks to you. Call ONLY when the user explicitly asks, e.g. 'switch to typing' or 'let's talk by voice'.
